notes.title: Small fixes and improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added the ending of the story to the stories section within the help menu. Also added a button to replay the ending.
[*]Fixing visual bug, where the arrows for controlling the snake would blink when automatic walking is enabled
[*]Corrected number of optimal steps in a level
[/list]

notes.title: One year anniversary sale
notes.content: "A Snake In A Maze" has been on Steam for over a year now and we want to celebrate. Starting May 16th, you can purchase the game for 80% of the original price for one week.
